text:
Sasha: heads-up — onboarding sparrow11b (mistral-style heads but qwen proj order) into the int4 pipeline. after conversion logits look ok for short ctx but diverge on longer prompts, and attention warmth shifts. attaching quick logs.
Miguel: can you paste the conversion flags and the proj layout? is this the project-order vs proj-transpose issue we saw earlier? :thinking:
Sasha: config excerpt:
```json
{"convert_flags": ["--int4","--keep_proj_order=false","--transpose_qkv=false"], "head_dim": 64, "n_heads": 32}
```
Sasha: note we kept proj_order=false because converter assumed gemma-style proj layout. when we set keep_proj_order=true the immediate short-run numbers match reference but longctx still drifts.
Rachel: what's the symptom on longctx? probability mass shift or wrong tokens? any consistent bias?
Sasha: mainly softmax temperature shift — commonsense completions get repetitive after ~512 tokens. log-odds compared to fp16 reference show a slow ramp toward low-entropy outputs.
Ben: could be kv cache interop — if head packing differs you can end up with cross-head interference that accumulates. also check rotary/pos handshake: if rotary scale or base freq assumed different, it slowly corrupts attention weights over time.
Miguel: try patch: when converting, force both `--transpose_qkv=true` and `--keep_proj_order=true` and produce a val run with the same seed. also run a KV-only pass where you only step cache warmup with context filling to see if divergence starts at warmup or after autoreg generation.
Sasha: ok i'll run that. quick repro command I'm using:
```
python convert.py --src sparrow11b.pt --dst sparrow11b.rwd --int4 --quant-profile="balanced" --keep_proj_order=true --transpose_qkv=true
python eval.py --model sparrow11b.rwd --task long-completion --seed 42 --log-every 50
```
Rachel: also try swapping the rotary base scalar — some mistral-era exports used an implicit sqrt scale in the kernel. small mismatch looks like a temp ramp rather than outright token swap.
Ben: if that fails, dump intermediate attention matrices for same step for fp16 and int4 and diff the normalization pre-softmax. that usually tells if it's a k/v mixing vs rotary misapply.
Sasha: ran quick KV warmup test — divergence shows up immediately after 2nd generation step, not only warmup. attaching diff snapshot later.
triage-bot: Reminder: open a conversion-interop ticket with model_name=sparrow11b, seed=42, and attach the diff tarball. Use label=eng-ml/interop and priority=high if customer-facing.
Miguel: thanks — if we confirm it's proj ordering, we can add a small autodetect: check shape pattern of q/k/v blocks for magic offsets and flip flags automatically. saves manual flags.
Sasha: noted. i'll push the eval artifacts to /mnt/eng-ml/sparrow11b/warmup-diffs and open the ticket. will report back with the attention diffs and quant histograms. :thumbsup:
